International Monetary Fund (IMF) guidelines ( GFSM2014 ) are monitored for changes that need to be taken into account in the recording of government debt.
The transition to conform with the guidelines in BPM6 is foreseen in 2017.
The Harmonized Commodity Description and Coding System is used for collection, compilation, and dissemination of international merchandise trade statistics.
Follows SNA 93 guidelines and ISIC Rev 3.1
Commodities are classified using both the Harmonized System (HS) and the Standard International Trade Classification (SITC) Rev.3.
Classification System Economic activities are classified using the International Standard Industrial Classification, Revision 3.1 (ISIC Rev 3.1).
Goods are classified using both the Harmonised System (HS) and Standard Industrial Trade Classification (SITC) Rev. 3, however data is published only in SITC Rev. 3 format.
Economic activities are classified using the International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC) of all Economic Activities, Revision 3.
Commodities are classified using both the Harmonized System (HS) and Standard International Trade Classification (SITC) Rev. 3.
Economic activities are classified using the International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC) Of all Economic Activities, Revision 3.

The methodology, concepts, definitions, and presentation of key aggregates in the depository corporations survey are based on the framework presented in the Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide (MFSMCG) 2016 .

The methodology, concepts, definitions, and presentation of key central bank aggregates are based on the framework presented in the Monetary and Financial Statistics Manual and Compilation Guide (MFSMCG) 2016 .

Since 2013 (data for the reference year of 2012), the balance of payments (BOP) statistics of Macao SAR have been compiled in accordance with the concepts, definitions, and classifications in the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, sixth edition (BPM6).
Government Finance Statistics (GFS) data adopted by the classification concepts of GFSM2014 are compiled on cash basis.
Government Finance Statistics (GFS) data adopted by the classification concepts of GFSM2014 are compiled on cash basis.
The definition of international reserves follows the recommendations of the Balance of Payments and International Investment Position Manual, sixth edition (BPM6).
The classification list is based on ISIC rev.3 with minor modifications to cater for the situation of Macao.

2.3.1 Classification/sectorization - For compilation of external merchandise trade statistics, the classification of merchandise is based on the Harmonized System (HS 2017), which contains 6641 commodity subdivisions at 8-digit level.
The definitions, classifications, valuation and time of recording of the different questionnaires are in line with the recommendations of SNA 2008.

For the production-based GDP, all the economic activities are classified according to the Classification of Economic Activities of Macao (CAM, Rev. 1) , which is an adaptation of the International Standard Industrial Classification (ISIC, Rev. 3) .
For manufacturing activities - broad classification according to ISIC Rev3.1.
Commodities are classified using both the Harmonised System (HS) and Standard International Trade Classification (SITC) Rev. 3 & Rev. 4.
Economic activities are classified using the International Standard Industrial Classification of All Economic Activities, revision 3.1 (ISIC Rev3.1).
